display.purpose: Product name in the masthead only.

body.purpose: Masthead supporting copy and readable prose.

ui.purpose: Form labels, table cells, summaries, hints.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, table headers, status chips, machine meta.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square chartreuse commit control for starting a scan.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid #b7db7a; background: #b7db7a; color: #182016; padding: 13px 18px; cursor: pointer; font: 700 1rem "Source Sans 3 Variable", "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #b7db7a33; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Cancel Button
components.description: Destructive-adjacent cancel control in the export bar.
components.css: .ds-btn-cancel { border: 1px solid #81564e; background: transparent; color: #ef9277; padding: 8px 11px; cursor: pointer; font: 700 0.8rem "Source Sans 3 Variable", "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; } .ds-btn-cancel:hover { background: #351f1d; } .ds-btn-cancel:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ef927733; }

components.name: Export Chip
components.css: .ds-export-chip { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid #b7db7a; background: #b7db7a; color: #182016; padding: 8px 11px; text-decoration: none; font: 700 0.7rem "Source Sans 3 Variable", "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; } .ds-export-chip:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-export-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #b7db7a33; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square field well for website and sitemap URLs.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #bdc6b9; font: 400 0.78rem "Source Sans 3 Variable", "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #4a5b4a; border-radius: 0; background: #111611; color: #f4f0e5; padding: 13px 14px; font: inherit; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #b7db7a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #b7db7a33; }

components.name: Idle Status
components.description: Quiet idle status line before a scan starts.
components.html: No scan loaded — enter a website URL above. Results stay on this machine.
components.css: .ds-idle { margin: 0; color: #8c9a8a; font: 400 0.9rem/1.45 "Source Sans 3 Variable", "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Mark Badge
components.description: Compact rotated square JS mark in the masthead.
components.css: .ds-mark { display: grid; width: 36px; height: 36px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #718c58; color: #d7ef9e; font: 700 0.7rem ui-monospace, monospace; transform: rotate(4deg); background: transparent; }

components.name: Error Banner
components.description: Left-bar fault banner for scan/session errors.
components.html: Scan failed: target rejected by URL policy.
components.css: .ds-error { border: 1px solid #ef9277; color: #ffc0a8; background: #351f1d; padding: 12px 14px; font: 400 0.9rem "Source Sans 3 Variable", "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Mono uppercase page status with success/fault/partial colors.
components.html: ok fetch_error no_jsonld
components.css: .ds-status { font: 700 0.68rem ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-status-ok { color: #d7ef9e; } .ds-status-fault { color: #ef9277; } .ds-status-partial { color: #e0bd76; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: JSON-LD evidence pre block inside page detail.
components.css: .ds-code { max-width: 100%; overflow: auto; margin: 0; padding: 12px; background: #101611; color: #c6d6bb; font: 400 0.72rem/1.5 ui-monospace, monospace; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; border-radius: 0; }

narrative.overview:
JSON Schemer’s UI is a dense, operational, slightly editorial workspace for local structured-data evidence. It reads like a field terminal grown into moss and parchment: near-black ground, olive panel surfaces, chartreuse as scarce signal, and a Georgia display mark that keeps the brand from feeling like generic SaaS chrome.

Surfaces stay sharp and instrumental. Borders and tonal layering do the work of depth. Corners stay square. Typography splits labor cleanly: Georgia serif for brand and metrics, self-hosted Source Sans 3 for reading and controls, monospace for labels, status, and JSON. The system rejects SaaS purple, glassmorphism, and rounded marketing cards.
keyCharacteristics: Dark olive terminal atmosphere with parchment text
Tripartite type: Georgia / Source Sans 3 / mono
Operate-scale product title (capped ~2.25rem), not Persuade display
Flat tonal panels; lift reserved for focus and future overlays

rules.name: The Signal Budget Rule
rules.body: Chartreuse is for actions, links, and status success only; don’t flood panels with it.

rules.name: The Evidence Type Rule
rules.body: Georgia for brand/metrics display; Source Sans 3 for UI body; mono for labels, status, JSON.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are flat tonal panels. Shadows appear only for focus rings or future overlay elevation.

rules.name: The Zero-Radius Rule
rules.body: Corners stay square (0); no pill buttons or marketing card radii.

dos: Do keep corners at 0 and borders at 1px tonal strokes.
Do spend Chartreuse Signal on primary actions, exports, links, and focus only.
Do use Georgia for the product name and metric figures; Source Sans 3 for body/controls; mono for labels, status, and JSON.
Do prefer dense operational layout (shell → setup → progress → table/detail) over dashboard card grids.
Do keep error and partial states in Coral Fault / Amber Partial — never invent a third accent family.
donts: Don’t introduce SaaS purple, indigo glows, or gradient text.
Don’t use glassmorphism, heavy multi-layer shadows, or rounded marketing cards.
Don’t round buttons into pills or soft-UI radii.
Don’t flood panel backgrounds with chartreuse fills.
Don’t mix display/body/mono roles (e.g. Georgia for table cells, Source Sans 3 for the product name).
Don't restore landing-hero masthead sizes or put a kicker above the product title.
